defectsFoundAndFixed.title: The AI feature was dead for every first-time visitor
defectsFoundAndFixed.evidence: Browser call to /functions/ai-gateway/executions returned 401 `user_unauthorized — No permissions provided for action 'execute'`. The function was created with `execute: []`, so no client could invoke it. The UI degraded silently to the no-LLM answer, so nothing looked broken; the student simply never received a model answer.
defectsFoundAndFixed.whyTestsMissedIt: `npm test`, `tsc --noEmit` and `vite build` all pass — none of them call the deployed function from a browser with a guest session. `ai-golden.mjs` and `greenbook-rag.mjs --deployed` call it with an APPWRITE_API_KEY, which is authorized regardless of the `execute` permission.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Set execute to `["any"]` and assert it in scripts/deploy/ai-gateway.mjs.
defectsFoundAndFixed.verification: Guest browser call now returns status completed / HTTP 200 with a real grounded answer; live-ui.mjs reports zero failed requests.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Deployed function build was never activated
defectsFoundAndFixed.evidence: functions.get().deployment reported activate: false — the build existed and was ready but was not live.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Activation applied; scripts/deploy/ai-gateway.mjs already used the correct `updateFunctionDeployment` call.
defectsFoundAndFixed.verification: function serves /greenbook/ask with a live model (provider explabs-luna, model gpt-5.6-luna).

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Journey dates rendered in two different formats, flipping day/month order by machine
defectsFoundAndFixed.evidence: `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", …)` resolves against the HOST locale. On this vi-VN machine a custom journey rendered `Oct 1, 2026` while src/data/journeys.ts and the product intent use `1 Aug 2026`. `toLocaleDateString(undefined, …)` returned `1 thg 10, 2026`.
defectsFoundAndFixed.impact: A student in Ha Noi and a student in Singapore read the same journey with a different day/month order.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Pinned to `en-GB` with `timeZone: "UTC"` in a single DAY_MONTH_YEAR formatter; rejects unparseable values rather than printing Invalid Date. Documented that browser locale is a display preference, never the source of truth.
defectsFoundAndFixed.verification: Passport renders `Arrival 1 Oct 2026 · Return date open`; asserted in live-ui.mjs.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Raw chapter slugs leaked into student-facing copy
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Added dependency-free src/lib/greenbook/chapters.ts exporting CHAPTER_META/CHAPTER_ORDER/chapterTitle; store.ts re-exports them; no-llm.ts imports from chapters.ts so it stays Node-testable without the Appwrite browser client.
defectsFoundAndFixed.verification: Now renders `Landing and settling in: …`. greenbook-no-llm.test.mjs had asserted the bug and now asserts the copy.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Internal infrastructure reason shown to students
defectsFoundAndFixed.evidence: Status line read `Answer built from verified facts (no model available)`.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Replaced with `Guidance compiled from verified facts` — the no-LLM path is a supported answer mode, and its cause is our infrastructure, not the student's concern.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: 1 MB map library in the Explore critical path
defectsFoundAndFixed.evidence: Explore chunk was 1,042 kB minified (maplibre-gl + worker) and eagerly imported for a screen whose first paint is a category row and a list.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Lazy-loaded behind Suspense with a sized skeleton fallback holding layout.
defectsFoundAndFixed.verification: Explore chunk 1042 kB -> 18 kB; the 1 MB now loads as ExploreMap on demand.

remainingKnownIssues.title: cosmetic September abbreviation divergence
remainingKnownIssues.detail: The en-GB formatter renders September as `Sept` while hand-written seed labels use `Sep`. September is not in the seed journey date set, so nothing is inconsistent today; documented in-code so a future seeded September aligns to the formatter rather than forking the format.

remainingKnownIssues.title: no INP field measurement
remainingKnownIssues.detail: INP requires real user interaction telemetry. The worst observed interaction event duration was 16ms, which is well inside the 200ms budget but is a lab proxy, not field INP.
